question: does a queryable WhatsApp message DB exist on cell or awrawr-pc?
finding: No WhatsApp message database exists on the cell or awrawr-pc. The live WhatsApp surface is the Hatch-managed linked channel (server-side store, not locally queryable). Local artifacts are: Membrane skill definition (CLI not installed), librefang channel catalog entry, openfang whatsapp-gateway source tree. There is no local 'WhatsApp DB' to mine for container/agent IDs; the interesting metadata lives in agent.* ledger tables, covered by R8c.
